prompts.glove-clean-alpha.txt:
Use case: background-extraction
Edit the supplied glove pointer. Keep exactly the same glove, finger direction, hand shape, cartoon ink lines, material shading, scuffs, colours, framing and detail. Remove ONLY the diffuse brown/black glow or hazy shadow outside the glove's actual dark ink contour. The background outside that clean contour must be completely transparent. Make the glove interior fully opaque while retaining smooth antialiased edge pixels. Do not cut away the dark ink outline. Do not add a checkerboard or any new background. This needs to be a clean, compact game HUD cutout without a surrounding glow cloud.
prompts.glove-pointer.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone transparent game HUD marker sprite.
Create one bold cartoon white glove hand pointing directly RIGHT with a single straight extended index finger. Three other fingers curl into the palm, with a clearly separate folded thumb. Chunky rounded rubber-hose cartoon anatomy, big knuckles, broad rolled cuff on the LEFT, no arm beyond the cuff. Like the white cartoon glove worn by a punk skeleton skateboarder named Boneman: warm ivory fabric, confident charcoal ink contour, a few dark stitch/crease marks, a slightly mischievous handmade grunge look. The pointing fingertip must be unambiguous and end at the rightmost edge of the hand.
Render the hand as a premium painted 3D-style game HUD cutout: rounded dimensional shading, clean pale highlight edges, soft cool gray shadow facets, slight warm reflected gold light. Keep it very readable at 50 pixels wide. The index finger lies exactly horizontally and the fingertip sits near the vertical midpoint. Full glove visible, 12% clear padding around all sides. No motion blur, no text, no logos, no marker line, no gauge, no background object, no giant shadow, no pointing left. Genuinely transparent alpha background; never paint a checkerboard.
prompts.meter-1.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: frame 1 of a four-frame stop-motion punk/grunge game balance meter.
Edit the supplied finished meter as another drawing of the SAME curved opening-parenthesis gauge. Pull the middle of the bow slightly farther left, with a small angular twitch in the upper third and one different chunky nick near the lower third.
The pose difference should be visible but restrained, around 4–6% of the arc's horizontal span. Keep the same total height, similar width, and the same pointed top and bottom endpoint positions. Keep the meter continuous with a slender playable arc and keep both tips on the right. Maintain its exact warm polished Roo-style gold/orange bevel material, red danger zones at BOTH ends, bright gold center, and premium antialiasing. Slightly change the reflected edge glints with the new facets. It should feel like hand-animated cutout artwork changing frames, never a blurry motion smear.
ONLY the meter. No marker, glove, pointer, text, ticks, icons, scale marks or other objects. Keep the complete artwork and generous clear margins. A genuinely transparent alpha background, not black paint or a checkerboard. Preserve the existing finished art quality.

prompts.meter-base.txt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone transparent game HUD balance-meter sprite.
Input images: image 1 is the approved Roo parenthesis artwork, a material/bevel/style reference. Image 2 is a skate-game screenshot showing only the desired long curved meter silhouette and proportions; do not recreate the scene.
Create a single long slender curved balance gauge shaped like an opening parenthesis: (. It opens to the RIGHT, with both tapered pointed ends to the right and the outer bow extending left in the middle. The complete arc is continuous. Its height is about 3.2 times its overall horizontal span; the band itself is much thinner than that span, with a clearly readable broad front face. Front orthographic view, no perspective tilt.
Match the approved Roo HUD artwork's extremely polished carved bevels and antialiasing. Warm golden yellow around the middle of the arc grades smoothly to orange and vermilion at BOTH pointed end zones, which are the danger ends. Add a restrained punk-rock hand-painted/grunge character: a few deliberate angular nicks on the outline, subtle scuffs on the broad face, lively asymmetric bevel facets. Still clean and readable at a 240-pixel display height. Thin dark ink accents are fine; no enormous black stroke or drop shadow.
There is NO marker, pointer, arrow, glove, text, numbers, ticks, logo, glow cloud or scene in this asset. It is only the complete curved gauge, with 12% clear padding and a genuinely transparent alpha background. Do not paint a checkerboard pattern. The interior opening and exterior are both fully transparent. Crisp, premium game UI sprite, centered, portrait composition.
